content.rendered:
Registration for Kindergarten is available online. Incoming Kindergarten students must turn 5 on or before September 1, 2023. Registering early helps the school and the district start planning for classrooms.

During online registration, new families will create a Sherwood ParentVUE account. Parents of current and former Sherwood students will log in with their existing ParentVUE account.

Paper registration packets are also available if preferred. The school office is closed for the summer June 26th – August 16th. During this time, you may pick up a packet at our District Office, Monday through Thursday, 8:00am-4:00pm.

Please read the Kindergarten Special Edition newsletter with summer dates and kinder readiness information.
